lots.key_photo_findings: One photo. Chalked 1113 and 2/10/26 (the sale date), white lot sticker 1113. Fresh band-saw marks, live edges with bark still attached on both sides and a deep bark-filled wane at lower left. Enlarged crop shows several long dark red-brown streaks running with the grain (open checks or gum/resin veins), a decayed knot with a bark pocket near the lower right, and splits and ragged bark at the bottom end. Colour is pale and fairly even, not the richer honey-gold of seasoned Huon, though fresh-sawn Huon is paler. Neighbouring slabs look like the same timber. No end grain, no scale.
